profile_text.body:
Decagon is an AI company whose platform is designed to build, optimize, and scale AI agents for customer support. The company describes itself as offering "an AI concierge for every customer," with a focus on delivering personalized experiences across the entire customer lifecycle for enterprise brands.

The core product, also called Decagon, is a customer support agent platform that the company characterizes as omnichannel and model-agnostic. It includes a monitoring component called Watchtower and emphasizes tools for testing, observability, and experimentation so that deployed agents can be validated and refined over time. Decagon is categorized as an enterprise AI platform with agent orchestration capabilities.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for the company.
